reference.current_orders:
WITH ranked AS (
 SELECT event_id,order_id,source_version,order_date,status,amount_cents,
 ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY source_version DESC) AS rn
 FROM accepted_events)
SELECT order_id,source_version,order_date,status,amount_cents FROM ranked WHERE rn=1
reference.daily_revenue:
SELECT order_date,
 SUM(CASE WHEN status='paid' THEN amount_cents ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_cents,
 SUM(CASE WHEN status='paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS eligible_order_count
FROM current_orders GROUP BY order_date

alternative.accepted_events:
WITH ranked AS (
 SELECT event_id,order_id,source_version,order_date,event_time,status,amount_cents,
 ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY event_id ORDER BY delivery_id) AS rn
 FROM raw_deliveries)
SELECT event_id,order_id,source_version,order_date,event_time,status,amount_cents
FROM ranked WHERE rn=1
alternative.current_orders:
SELECT e.order_id,e.source_version,e.order_date,e.status,e.amount_cents
FROM accepted_events e
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accepted_events newer
 WHERE newer.order_id=e.order_id AND newer.source_version>e.source_version)
alternative.daily_revenue:
WITH dates AS (SELECT DISTINCT order_date FROM current_orders),
paid AS (SELECT order_date,SUM(amount_cents) AS cents,COUNT(*) AS n
 FROM current_orders WHERE status='paid' GROUP BY order_date)
SELECT dates.order_date,COALESCE(paid.cents,0) AS revenue_cents,
COALESCE(paid.n,0) AS eligible_order_count
FROM dates LEFT JOIN paid ON paid.order_date=dates.order_date

dedup_transport.sql:
SELECT event_id,order_id,source_version,order_date,event_time,status,amount_cents
FROM raw_deliveries GROUP BY delivery_id

dedup_amount.sql:
SELECT event_id,order_id,source_version,order_date,event_time,status,amount_cents
FROM raw_deliveries GROUP BY amount_cents

latest_received.sql:
WITH x AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY received_at DESC) AS rn FROM raw_deliveries)
SELECT order_id,source_version,order_date,status,amount_cents FROM x WHERE rn=1

earliest_version.sql:
WITH x AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY source_version ASC) AS rn FROM accepted_events)
SELECT order_id,source_version,order_date,status,amount_cents FROM x WHERE rn=1

sum_all_versions.sql:
SELECT order_date,SUM(amount_cents) AS revenue_cents,COUNT(*) AS eligible_order_count
FROM accepted_events GROUP BY order_date

count_cancelled.sql:
SELECT order_date,SUM(CASE WHEN status='paid' THEN amount_cents ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_cents,
COUNT(*) AS eligible_order_count FROM current_orders GROUP BY order_date

drop_zero_date.sql:
SELECT order_date,SUM(amount_cents) AS revenue_cents,COUNT(*) AS eligible_order_count
FROM current_orders WHERE status='paid' GROUP BY order_date

attribute_receipt_date.sql:
SELECT SUBSTR(received_at,1,10) AS order_date,SUM(amount_cents) AS revenue_cents,COUNT(*) AS eligible_order_count
FROM raw_deliveries WHERE status='paid' GROUP BY SUBSTR(received_at,1,10)

starter.accepted_events:
SELECT event_id,order_id,source_version,order_date,event_time,status,amount_cents
FROM raw_deliveries
-- Return each business event once; transport receipts can repeat.
WHERE 1=0
starter.current_orders:
SELECT order_id,source_version,order_date,status,amount_cents
FROM accepted_events
-- Which source version wins for each order?
WHERE 1=0
starter.daily_revenue:
SELECT order_date,0 AS revenue_cents,0 AS eligible_order_count
FROM current_orders
-- One row per order date, including dates with no paid latest state.
WHERE 1=0
